orgId.description: Organization ID to use for this operation. If unspecified, inferred from token. Token must have permission to interact with this organization.

urlExpiration.description: Expiration time of returned s3 url (in minutes).

taskIds.description: Comma separated list of taskIds to gather captures for. Maximum number of taskIds allowed are 10

includeSegments.description: Flag; (true) for individual capture segments of main recording, (false) for a stitched capture.

includeVARecordings.description: Flag; (true) for including virtual agent (VA) recordings, (false) for excluding virtual agent recordings. The default value is false.
